usermeta.purpose: Visualizes regional beef industry rates of return (%) above and below a 0% baseline across MLA regions from 2000 to 2024.
usermeta.chartType: Diverging Grouped Bar Chart with Zero Reference Rule

title.text: Beef Industry Rate of Return Across MLA Regions (2000–2024)
title.subtitle: Diverging annual rate of return (%) above and below 0% baseline

data._comment: Loads 25-year regional beef industry yearly performance dataset

transform._comment: Step 1: Filter out records lacking valid region or rate of return entries
Step 2: Aggregate average rate of return per year and region

layer.description: LAYER 1: Grouped bar chart with positive/negative bars diverging from the 0% midline
LAYER 2: Horizontal reference rule anchored at Y = 0 to emphasize positive vs. negative divergence
